title: A Ember for the Veil Revisited
author: Dominic Thackeray
blurb: Emrys Kavanagh, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
